book.a: Booking a visit takes three steps:
steps: On the Doctors page, find a doctor by specialty or city.
On the doctor's profile, press "Book a visit".
Pick a day and a free time, then confirm. The booking is confirmed automatically.

upload.q: How do I upload a lab result?
upload.a: A lab result is added to your medical record:
steps: Enter the date and a title, attach a PDF or an image, and save.

cancel.a: You can cancel or reschedule a visit up to 2 hours before it starts:
steps: On the Appointments page, open the visit.

language.a: Use the globe icon at the top of any page, or the Language section on your Profile page. Uzbek, Russian and English are available.

operator.a: Operators work daily from 9:00 to 18:00. Type your question here and an operator will reply. If it is urgent: +998 71 200 00 00.

schedule.q: How do I set up my schedule?
schedule.a: Your working hours are set on the Schedule page:
steps: Turn on your working days and enter start and end times for each.
Choose the length of one visit (slot) — free times are split accordingly.
Save. Patients can only book those times.

summary.q: Where do I write a summary?
summary.a: A summary is written from the appointment page or from the patient's record:
steps: On the Appointments page, open a completed visit.
Enter the diagnosis and recommendations, then save.
The summary appears in the patient's record.

record.q: How do I see a patient's record?
record.a: You can open the record of any patient who has an active or past visit with you. Entries the patient marked "Only me" are not shown.
steps: Pick the patient on the Patients page.
Filter the entries, or print them with "Print / PDF".

language.a: Use the globe icon at the top, or the Language section on your Profile page.

operator.a: Operators work daily from 9:00 to 18:00. Type your question here and an operator will reply. If it is urgent: +998 71 200 00 00.

applications.q: How do I review an application?
applications.a: New doctor applications are on the Applications page:
steps: Open the application and check the documents.
Approve it if everything is in order; otherwise reject it with a reason.

block.q: How do I block a doctor?
block.a: On the Doctors page, open the doctor and press "Block". A blocked doctor is hidden from search and gets no new bookings.

reviews.a: On the Reviews page you can look through new and reported reviews, and hide or keep them.

language.a: Use the globe icon at the top, or the Language section on your Profile page.
